values.Can I also activate this card's [Main] e: Yes, you can. In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you only place this card in your security stack.
values.What happens to cards placed face up in: They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.
values.What happens upon a security check for a: The check is performed with the card left revealed. Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard checks.
values.What happens if I shuffle a security sta: Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. After shuffling, those cards are left face-down.
